questions.sourceAuditQuestion: After the exact create request is accepted but its response body is lost, which merchant-controlled pre-write value retrieves precisely that object without repeating create?
questions.questionEn: After the exact create-booking/create-transaction/payment request is accepted, but the TCP/TLS connection closes before PadlHub receives the response body, which merchant-controlled value supplied before that request retrieves precisely that object without repeating the create command?
questions.questionRu: После того как точный запрос create-booking/create-transaction/payment принят, но TCP/TLS-соединение закрывается до получения PadlHub тела ответа, какое управляемое мерчантом значение, переданное до запроса, позволяет получить именно созданный объект без повторения команды create?
questions.criticalReason: Lost-response recovery requires a stable value created before egress; otherwise a retry may duplicate a booking or payment effect.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Name the exact request field or header, its format and scope, and the exact production lookup operation that returns one matching object after an accepted-but-unanswered request.
requiredEvidence: Versioned production API schema for the create operation
Versioned production API schema for lookup by the pre-write value
insufficientAnswers: A generic statement that duplicate prevention is supported
A provider-generated identifier available only in the lost response
A UI/report search or an undocumented example
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep the writer and authoritative read-back gates NO-GO; keep ambiguous transport outcomes UNKNOWN and do not repeat create.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: For the exact create operation, what is the idempotency key location, uniqueness scope, retention, same-payload replay, changed-payload behavior, timeout/reset behavior and post-retention behavior?
questions.questionEn: For that exact create operation, what is the idempotency header or field, uniqueness scope and retention; what happens for same key/same payload, same key/changed payload, timeout/reset, and a retry after the retention window?
questions.questionRu: Для этой точной операции create укажите header или field идемпотентности, область уникальности и срок хранения; что происходит при одинаковом ключе и payload, одинаковом ключе и изменённом payload, timeout/reset и повторе после окончания срока хранения?
questions.criticalReason: Exact-operation replay semantics are required to prevent a duplicate side effect after an ambiguous transport result.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Document the exact operation, key location, uniqueness scope, TTL, replay response, changed-payload conflict and no-extra-effect guarantees for timeout/reset and post-retention retry.
requiredEvidence: Versioned OpenAPI or API reference for the exact create operation
Exact status codes and response bodies for replay and conflict
insufficientAnswers: An unqualified yes
Client-side deduplication only
A sample request without retention or changed-payload semantics
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep realProviderWriter NO-GO and prohibit blind retry after timeout or connection reset.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Which current production read endpoint looks up by the merchant-controlled value, what is its cardinality, how are never-created, not-yet-visible, deleted, expired and rejected distinguished, and what are the consistency window, history retention and rate limits?
questions.questionEn: Which current production read endpoint looks up the object by that merchant-controlled value; can it return multiple matches; and how are never-created, not-yet-visible, deleted, expired and rejected distinguished? State the consistency window, history retention and rate limits.
questions.questionRu: Какой текущий production read endpoint ищет объект по этому управляемому мерчантом значению; может ли он вернуть несколько совпадений; как различаются never-created, not-yet-visible, deleted, expired и rejected? Укажите окно консистентности, срок хранения истории и rate limits.
questions.criticalReason: A report, UI event or generic NOT_FOUND cannot establish an authoritative negative lookup or justify a second mutation.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Provide the exact production GET/search operation, lookup field, auth scope, cardinality, status/error model, visibility bound, retention and rate-limit contract.
insufficientAnswers: A transaction report or dashboard screenshot
A 404 without documented negative semantics
Widget success/failure telemetry
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep NOT_FOUND and delayed provider appearance UNKNOWN; keep writer, read-back, SHADOW, WARN and BLOCK NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: List every order, booking, payment and transaction identifier, its first availability, scope, retention, reuse and production/demo differences.
questions.questionEn: List every provider-generated order, booking, payment and transaction identifier, when it first exists, where it appears in create response/read-back/callback, its scope, reuse rules and production/demo differences.
questions.questionRu: Перечислите все генерируемые провайдером идентификаторы order, booking, payment и transaction: когда каждый впервые появляется, где присутствует в create response/read-back/callback, его область, правила повторного использования и различия production/demo.
questions.criticalReason: PadlHub must bind one tenant operation to immutable provider objects without assuming that a transaction ID is a reservation key.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Supply a field-by-field identifier lifecycle and uniqueness matrix for production and demo, including create, read-back and callback availability.
requiredEvidence: Written identifier uniqueness, scope, retention and reuse rules
insufficientAnswers: A list of example IDs without lifecycle guarantees
A statement that IDs are unique without scope
Treating one transaction ID as one booking without allocation evidence
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep identifier binding UNPROVEN and the affected gates NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Provide the current production booking/payment state machine and identify terminal and reversible statuses.
questions.questionEn: Provide the current production state machine and identify terminal/reversible statuses for accepted, rejected, failed, cancelled, expired, authorized, captured, settled, refunded, partially refunded, reversed and charged back.
questions.questionRu: Предоставьте текущую production state machine и укажите terminal/reversible статусы для accepted, rejected, failed, cancelled, expired, authorized, captured, settled, refunded, partially refunded, reversed и charged back.
questions.criticalReason: Paid facts may later be partially or fully refunded, so a single visible status cannot safely drive convergence.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Provide a versioned state and transition table with terminality, reversibility, ordering, timestamps and rules for partial refund, reversal and chargeback.
insufficientAnswers: UI status labels
A list of statuses without transitions
An assertion that PAID is final without refund/reversal semantics
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep provider state mapping and livePaymentConvergence NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Which immutable read-back fields bind merchant, actor, exercise, booking/order/payment, merchant reference and provider transaction?
questions.questionEn: Which immutable read-back fields bind merchant/tenant, actor/client, exercise/game, booking/order/payment, merchant reference and provider transaction to the same operation?
questions.questionRu: Какие неизменяемые поля read-back связывают merchant/tenant, actor/client, exercise/game, booking/order/payment, merchant reference и provider transaction с одной и той же операцией?
questions.criticalReason: Acceptance requires an exact immutable match; otherwise another client, booking or payment may be confirmed.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Identify the authoritative immutable fields and exact response locations that jointly bind tenant, actor, business object, merchant reference and provider transaction.
requiredEvidence: Exact field mapping for one operation
insufficientAnswers: Matching by amount or timestamp alone
A mutable display name or phone number
A generic transaction ID without booking allocation
questions.noResponseDecision: Do not accept provider read-back as confirmation; keep the three affected gates NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Specify authoritative amount unit, scale, rounding and currency representation plus lifecycle, partial, fee, net, tip, reversal and chargeback facts.
questions.sourceQuestionEn: Specify amount unit/scale/rounding and authoritative currency representation in write, read-back and callback. Explain authorized, captured, settled, refunded, fee, net, tip, reversal/chargeback and multiple-transaction fields.
questions.questionEn: Specify amount unit/scale/rounding and authoritative currency representation in write, read-back and callback. Explain authorized, captured, settled, refunded, fee, net, tip, reversal/chargeback and multiple-transaction fields. State whether one transaction or payment can cover multiple positions or bookings, and identify the stable per-position or per-booking allocation ID.
questions.questionRu: Укажите единицу, scale и rounding суммы, а также authoritative представление currency в write, read-back и callback. Объясните поля authorized, captured, settled, refunded, fee, net, tip, reversal/chargeback и multiple-transaction. Укажите, может ли одна transaction или payment покрывать несколько positions или bookings, и назовите стабильный per-position или per-booking allocation ID.
questions.criticalReason: Transaction totals may cover multiple positions, and refunds or fees may alter displayed values; exact amount/currency allocation is required.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Provide versioned field definitions, units, ISO currency representation, rounding rules and allocation/lifecycle semantics for write, read-back and callback.
requiredEvidence: Written rounding and ISO currency rules
insufficientAnswers: A RUB-labeled report
Transaction total equality
Examples without unit, rounding or allocation guarantees
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep amount/currency verification and live convergence NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Provide callback signature/authentication, canonical payload, covered headers, timestamp/nonce, replay window, key rotation, environment separation and signed merchant/reference fields.
questions.sourceQuestionEn: Provide the production callback authentication/integrity contract: signature algorithm, canonical payload, covered headers, timestamp/nonce, allowed replay window, key distribution and rotation, environment separation, and signed merchant/reference fields.
questions.questionEn: First confirm whether Viva provides a distinct production payment-event callback/channel rather than only a generic notification webhook. If it does, provide its authentication/integrity contract: signature algorithm, canonical payload, covered headers, timestamp/nonce, allowed replay window, key distribution and rotation, environment separation, and signed merchant/reference fields.
questions.questionRu: Сначала подтвердите, предоставляет ли Viva отдельный production payment-event callback/channel, а не только generic notification webhook. Если предоставляет, опишите его contract аутентификации и целостности: алгоритм подписи, canonical payload, покрываемые headers, timestamp/nonce, допустимое replay window, распространение и rotation ключей, разделение окружений и подписанные merchant/reference fields.
questions.criticalReason: A generic webhook transport is not a secure payment callback; integrity, tenant binding and replay resistance must be independently verifiable.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: State whether a distinct production payment-event channel exists and, if so, provide the exact verification algorithm, signed bytes/headers, key lifecycle, timestamp/nonce checks, environment separation and signed tenant/object fields.
insufficientAnswers: IP allowlisting alone
TLS transport alone
An unsigned example payload or a generic webhook page
questions.noResponseDecision: Do not create a public callback route; keep callback gates NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Provide callback event-ID scope, retries, duplicate/order guarantees, old-after-new behavior, acknowledgement and non-2xx handling.
questions.questionEn: Provide callback event-ID scope, retry schedule, duplicate/order guarantees, old-after-new behavior, acknowledgement status/body and non-2xx handling.
questions.questionRu: Укажите область callback event ID, расписание retry, гарантии duplicate/order, поведение old-after-new, acknowledgement status/body и обработку non-2xx.
questions.criticalReason: Reliable observation requires deterministic dedupe, stale-event handling and bounded delivery semantics.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Document the unique event ID, its scope/retention, complete retry schedule, duplicate/order model, ACK contract and non-2xx behavior.
requiredEvidence: Event ID field and uniqueness/retention guarantee
insufficientAnswers: A statement that callbacks may be retried
Business-object ID used as an undocumented delivery ID
An example delivery without duplicate/order guarantees
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep callback consumption and callback acceleration NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Provide current production OpenAPI/reference and changelog URLs, supported version, deprecation policy and written demo/production parity.
questions.questionEn: Provide current production OpenAPI/API-reference and changelog URLs, exact supported version, deprecation policy, and written confirmation of demo/sandbox versus production parity.
questions.questionRu: Предоставьте текущие production URL OpenAPI/API reference и changelog, точную поддерживаемую версию, deprecation policy и письменное подтверждение parity между demo/sandbox и production.
questions.criticalReason: Unversioned or demo-only material cannot establish the contract used by the production merchant account.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Identify the authoritative production contract version, environment applicability, changelog and deprecation timeline, with accessible versioned documents or attachments.
insufficientAnswers: Marketing documentation
An undated API example
HTTP 401 or 404 observations
A generic statement that environments are similar

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Define production connect/request timeout expectations, 429 and Retry-After, retryable versus nonretryable status and transport classes, rate-limit scope, maximum retry rate and horizon, backoff and jitter, circuit-breaker trip/half-open/recovery probes, read-after-write consistency, maintenance behavior and provider SLOs.
questions.questionEn: Define production connect/request timeout expectations; 429 and Retry-After; retryable versus nonretryable HTTP/provider/transport classes; rate-limit scope; maximum retry rate and horizon; required exponential backoff/jitter; circuit-breaker trip, half-open and recovery probes; read-after-write consistency; maintenance behavior; and provider SLOs.
questions.questionRu: Определите production ожидания для connect/request timeout; 429 и Retry-After; retryable и nonretryable классы HTTP/provider/transport; область rate limit; максимальную частоту и горизонт retry; обязательные exponential backoff/jitter; circuit-breaker trip, half-open и recovery probes; read-after-write consistency; поведение при maintenance и provider SLO.
questions.criticalReason: Timeout, retry and consistency policy must be provider-valid; otherwise recovery can amplify failures or create duplicate effects.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Provide production operational limits, error taxonomy, retry and breaker policy, consistency windows, maintenance behavior and SLOs with exact version/environment scope.
requiredEvidence: Error taxonomy, consistency and maintenance/SLO documentation
insufficientAnswers: Use standard retries
Undocumented observed timing
A quota without scope or recovery horizon
questions.noResponseDecision: Do not schedule real or shadow provider traffic; keep all gates NO-GO.

questions.sourceAuditQuestion: Define permitted provider correlation values in logs/traces, retention and redaction, forbidden merchant/reference/client/body fields, allowed low-cardinality metric labels and failure/rate-limit/circuit isolation per tenant, merchant and acquiring integration.
questions.questionEn: Define which provider correlation values may appear in logs/traces, their retention and redaction; which merchant/reference/client/body fields are forbidden; allowed low-cardinality metric labels; and how failure/rate-limit/circuit state is isolated per tenant, merchant and acquiring integration.
questions.questionRu: Определите, какие provider correlation values могут присутствовать в logs/traces, их retention и redaction; какие merchant/reference/client/body fields запрещены; допустимые low-cardinality metric labels; и как failure/rate-limit/circuit state изолируется по tenant, merchant и acquiring integration.
questions.criticalReason: Provider payloads may contain client PII; observability must remain redacted, bounded and isolated without raw callback bodies.
questions.minimumAcceptableAnswer: Provide an official data-classification and observability policy covering permitted correlation fields, forbidden PII/body fields, retention/redaction and tenant/merchant/acquirer isolation.
requiredEvidence: Official provider data-classification or integration-security policy
Operational isolation and low-cardinality metric guidance
insufficientAnswers: Log what is needed
An oral assurance
Raw callback-body retention
IP allowlisting presented as message integrity
questions.noResponseDecision: Keep raw-body storage prohibited and all provider-connected gates NO-GO.
